stem.text: Water from a reservoir is fed to the turbine of a hydroelectric system at a rate of $510\,\text{kg s}^{-1}$. The reservoir is $280\,\text{m}$ above the level of the turbine.
The electrical output from the generator driven by the turbine is a current of $205\,\text{A}$ at a potential difference of $5800\,\text{V}$.
What is the efficiency of the system?
